title: Record relevance decisions and reviews in the existing GraphQL models
description:
No new tables. A decision is a SemanticRelation with predicate relevance_decision_is from the Reference lineage to SemanticNode relevance.include or relevance.exclude, using the existing fields score (probability of include), confidence, classifierId, modelVersion (cyclotron version) and reviewRecommended, with metadata {decisionId, reviewReason, propensity, cycle}. Register the predicate in corpora/papyrus-semantic-relation-types.yml and lib/semantic-graph.ts, excluded from knowledge queries like other workflow relations. A review stays the existing reviewReferenceCuration mutation (amplify/data/resource.ts, amplify/functions/category-action/handler.ts), extended with optional decisionRelationId and shareable flags stored in the reference_curation Message metadata. The label rule is the existing scopeTrainingLabelForReference (lib/reference-policy.ts) and scope_training_label_for_reference. The status snapshot is a KnowledgeRawPayload row cyclotron-status-<cyclotronId> holding cyclotron-status/v1, the same pattern as the Newsroom summary snapshot. Ordering: after the configuration task.

Acceptance criteria:
- Handler specs show the mutation stores decisionRelationId and shareable, and still works without them.
- A superseded decision (new cyclotron version) is marked superseded, not deleted; the current one is unique per Reference lineage.
- Knowledge queries return no relevance_decision_is relations by default.
- The References view model can read the current decision for a Reference without an extra round trip per row.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on feature/PPY-4ac3d0-cyclotron-decisions (built on feature/PPY-cc99d6-cyclotron-config): relevance_decision_is relation type (domain workflow, so knowledge queries exclude it) in corpora/papyrus-semantic-relation-types.yml and lib/semantic-graph.ts; src/papyrus_content/relevance_decisions.py (decision node and relation records reusing score, confidence, classifierId, modelVersion, reviewRecommended; superseding; status snapshot as KnowledgeRawPayload with a raw_payload attachment; label from the existing scope-training rule); reviewReferenceCuration gains optional decisionRelationId and shareable (schema.ts and resource.ts, metadata via amplify/functions/shared/reference-curation-metadata.ts); lib/relevance-decisions.ts reads current decisions from loaded relations. Specs: features_backend/cyclotron-relevance-records.feature (story PPY-106510, 9 scenarios) and scripts/test-relevance-decisions.ts (in test:ci:ts). Schema parity ok; typecheck clean apart from the pre-existing missing amplify outputs; no new pytest or BDD failures. Needs a sandbox/schema deploy for the two new mutation arguments before the UI uses them.

right_now_summary: Relevance decisions and reviews are recorded in existing models; sandbox deployment is needed before the UI uses new
